versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר דָּוִד֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֖י הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּיוֹם֩ הִצִּ֨יל יְהוָ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כָּל־אֹיְבָ֖יו וּמִכַּ֥ף שָׁאֽוּל׃

controles.web: David spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:
controles.kjv: And David spake unto the Lord the words of this song in the day that the Lord had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:
controles.livre: E falou Davi ao SENHOR as palavras deste cântico, o dia que o SENHOR o livrou da mão de todos os seus inimigos e da mão de Saul.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֛ה סַֽלְעִ֥י וּמְצֻדָתִ֖י וּמְפַלְטִי־לִֽי׃

controles.web: and he said,  “Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;
controles.kjv: And he said, The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;
controles.livre: E disse: O SENHOR é minha rocha, e minha fortaleza, e meu libertador;

versos.hebraico: אֱלֹהֵ֥י צוּרִ֖י אֶחֱסֶה־בּ֑וֹ מָגִנִּ֞י וְקֶ֣רֶן יִשְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּי֙ וּמְנוּסִ֔י מֹשִׁעִ֕י מֵחָמָ֖ס תֹּשִׁעֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: God, my rock, in him I will take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge. My savior, you save me from violence.
controles.kjv: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.
controles.livre: Deus de minha rocha, nele confiarei: Meu escudo, e o poder de minha salvação, minha fortaleza, e meu refúgio; Meu salvador, que me livrarás de violência.

versos.hebraico: מְהֻלָּ֖ל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּמֵאֹיְבַ֖י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃

controles.web: I will call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised: So shall I be saved from my enemies.
controles.kjv: I will call on the Lord, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
controles.livre: Invocarei ao SENHOR, digno de ser louvado. E serei salvo de meus inimigos.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֥י אֲפָפֻ֖נִי מִשְׁבְּרֵי־מָ֑וֶת נַחֲלֵ֥י בְלִיַּ֖עַל יְבַעֲתֻֽנִי׃

controles.web: For the waves of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
controles.kjv: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;
controles.livre: Quando me cercaram ondas de morte, E ribeiros de iniquidade me assombraram,

versos.hebraico: חֶבְלֵ֥י שְׁא֖וֹל סַבֻּ֑נִי קִדְּמֻ֖נִי מֹֽקְשֵׁי־מָֽוֶת׃

controles.web: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death caught me.
controles.kjv: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;
controles.livre: As cordas do mundo dos mortos me rodearam, e laços de morte me tomaram desprevenido.

versos.hebraico: בַּצַּר־לִי֙ אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֔ה וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַ֖י אֶקְרָ֑א וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע מֵהֵֽיכָלוֹ֙ קוֹלִ֔י וְשַׁוְעָתִ֖י בְּאָזְנָֽיו׃

controles.web: In my distress I called on Yahweh. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry came into his ears.
controles.kjv: In my distress I called upon the Lord, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears.
controles.livre: Tive angústia, invoquei ao SENHOR, E clamei a meu Deus: E ele ouviu minha voz desde seu templo; Chegou meu clamor a seus ouvidos.

versos.hebraico: ותגעש וַתִּרְעַשׁ֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ מוֹסְד֥וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַיִּֽתְגָּעֲשׁ֖וּ כִּֽי־חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
controles.kjv: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.
controles.livre: A terra se moveu, e tremeu; Os fundamentos dos céus foram movidos, E se estremeceram, porque ele se irou.

versos.hebraico: עָלָ֤ה עָשָׁן֙ בְּאַפּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֥שׁ מִפִּ֖יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּחָלִ֖ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: Smoke went up out of his nostrils. Fire out of his mouth devoured. Coals were kindled by it.
controles.kjv: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
controles.livre: Subiu fumaça de suas narinas, E de sua boca fogo consumidor, Pelo qual se acenderam carvões.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֥ט שָׁמַ֖יִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַעֲרָפֶ֖ל תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽיו׃

controles.web: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
controles.kjv: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet.
controles.livre: E abaixo os céus, e desceu: Uma escuridão debaixo de seus pés.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּרְכַּ֥ב עַל־כְּר֖וּב וַיָּעֹ֑ף וַיֵּרָ֖א עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רֽוּחַ׃

controles.web: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he was seen on the wings of the wind.
controles.kjv: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.
controles.livre: Subiu sobre o querubim, e voou: Apareceu-se sobre as asas do vento.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֥שֶׁת חֹ֛שֶׁךְ סְבִיבֹתָ֖יו סֻכּ֑וֹת חַֽשְׁרַת־מַ֖יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים׃

controles.web: He made darkness pavilions around himself: gathering of waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
controles.kjv: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
controles.livre: Armou tendas de escuridão ao redor de si; nuvens negras e espessas, carregadas de águas.

versos.hebraico: מִנֹּ֖גַהּ נֶגְדּ֑וֹ בָּעֲר֖וּ גַּחֲלֵי־אֵֽשׁ׃

controles.web: At the brightness before him, coals of fire were kindled.
controles.kjv: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.
controles.livre: Do resplendor de sua presença Se acenderam brasas ardentes.

versos.hebraico: יַרְעֵ֥ם מִן־שָׁמַ֖יִם יְהוָ֑ה וְעֶלְי֖וֹן יִתֵּ֥ן קוֹלֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Yahweh thundered from heaven. The Most High uttered his voice.
controles.kjv: The Lord thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.
controles.livre: O SENHOR trovejou desde os céus, E o Altíssimo deu sua voz;

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח חִצִּ֖ים וַיְפִיצֵ֑ם בָּרָ֖ק ויהמם׃

controles.web: He sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and confused them.
controles.kjv: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.
controles.livre: Lançou flechas, e desbaratou-os; Relampejou, e consumiu-os.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּֽרָאוּ֙ אֲפִ֣קֵי יָ֔ם יִגָּל֖וּ מֹסְד֣וֹת תֵּבֵ֑ל בְּגַעֲרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מִנִּשְׁמַ֖ת ר֥וּחַ אַפּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Then the channels of the sea appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare by the rebuke of Yahweh, At the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
controles.kjv: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the Lord, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
controles.livre: Então apareceram as profundezas do mar, E os fundamentos do mundo foram descobertos, À repreensão do SENHOR, Ao sopro do vento de seu nariz.

versos.hebraico: יִשְׁלַ֥ח מִמָּר֖וֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽמְשֵׁ֖נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃

controles.web: He sent from on high and he took me. He drew me out of many waters.
controles.kjv: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;
controles.livre: Estendeu sua mão do alto, e arrebatou-me, E tirou-me de copiosas águas.

versos.hebraico: יַצִּילֵ֕נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֖י עָ֑ז מִשֹּׂ֣נְאַ֔י כִּ֥י אָמְצ֖וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

controles.web: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.
controles.kjv: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.
controles.livre: Livrou-me de fortes inimigos, De aqueles que me aborreciam, os quais eram mais fortes que eu.

versos.hebraico: יְקַדְּמֻ֖נִי בְּי֣וֹם אֵידִ֑י וַיְהִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה מִשְׁעָ֖ן לִֽי׃

controles.web: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.
controles.kjv: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the Lord was my stay.
controles.livre: Atacaram-me no dia de minha calamidade; Mas o SENHOR foi meu apoio.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּצֵ֥א לַמֶּרְחָ֖ב אֹתִ֑י יְחַלְּצֵ֖נִי כִּי־חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי׃

controles.web: He also brought me out into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
controles.kjv: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
controles.livre: Tirou-me para um lugar amplo; Livrou-me, porque se agradou de mim.

versos.hebraico: יִגְמְלֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָדַ֖י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי׃

controles.web: Yahweh rewarded me according to my righteousness. He rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands.
controles.kjv: The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
controles.livre: Remunerou-me o SENHOR conforme minha justiça: E conforme a limpeza de minhas mãos ele me pagou.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֥י שָׁמַ֖רְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א רָשַׁ֖עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי׃

controles.web: For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
controles.kjv: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
controles.livre: Porque eu guardei os caminhos do SENHOR; E não me apartei impiamente de meu Deus.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֥י כָל־משפטו לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו לֹא־אָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

controles.web: For all his ordinances were before me. As for his statutes, I did not depart from them.
controles.kjv: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.
controles.livre: Porque diante de mim tenho todas suas ordenanças; E atento a seus estatutos, não me retirarei deles.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶהְיֶ֥ה תָמִ֖ים ל֑וֹ וָאֶשְׁתַּמְּרָ֖ה מֵעֲוֺנִֽי׃

controles.web: I was also perfect toward him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
controles.kjv: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.
controles.livre: E fui íntegro para com ele, E guardei-me de minha iniquidade.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֧שֶׁב יְהוָ֛ה לִ֖י כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹרִ֖י לְנֶ֥גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃

controles.web: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.
controles.kjv: Therefore the Lord hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.
controles.livre: Remunerou-me, portanto, o SENHOR conforme minha justiça, E conforme minha limpeza diante de seus olhos.

versos.hebraico: עִם־חָסִ֖יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם־גִּבּ֥וֹר תָּמִ֖ים תִּתַּמָּֽם׃

controles.web: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man you will show yourself perfect.
controles.kjv: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.
controles.livre: Com o bom és benigno, E com o íntegro te mostras íntegro;

versos.hebraico: עִם־נָבָ֖ר תִּתָּבָ֑ר וְעִם־עִקֵּ֖שׁ תִּתַּפָּֽל׃

controles.web: With the pure you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
controles.kjv: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.
controles.livre: Limpo és para com o limpo, Mas com o perverso és rígido.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־עַ֥ם עָנִ֖י תּוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינֶ֖יךָ עַל־רָמִ֥ים תַּשְׁפִּֽיל׃

controles.web: You will save the afflicted people, But your eyes are on the haughty, that you may bring them down.
controles.kjv: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.
controles.livre: E tu salvas ao povo humilde; Mas teus olhos sobre os altivos, para abatê-los.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה נֵירִ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וַיהוָ֖ה יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי׃

controles.web: For you are my lamp, Yahweh. Yahweh will light up my darkness.
controles.kjv: For thou art my lamp, O Lord: and the Lord will lighten my darkness.
controles.livre: Porque tu és minha lâmpada, ó SENHOR; o SENHOR dá luz às minhas trevas.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֥י בְכָ֖ה אָר֣וּץ גְּד֑וּד בֵּאלֹהַ֖י אֲדַלֶּג־שֽׁוּר׃

controles.web: For by you, I run against a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
controles.kjv: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.
controles.livre: Pois contigo avançarei contra uma tropa, e com o meu Deus saltarei uma muralha.

versos.hebraico: הָאֵ֖ל תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכּ֑וֹ אִמְרַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ צְרוּפָ֔ה מָגֵ֣ן ה֔וּא לְכֹ֖ל הַחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
controles.kjv: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the Lord is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.
controles.livre: O caminho de Deus é perfeito; a palavra do SENHOR é purificada, é escudo é de todos os que nele confiam.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֥י מִי־אֵ֖ל מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֖וּר מִֽבַּלְעֲדֵ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

controles.web: For who is God, besides Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God?
controles.kjv: For who is God, save the Lord? and who is a rock, save our God?
controles.livre: Porque que Deus há a não ser o SENHOR? Ou quem é forte a não ser nosso Deus?

versos.hebraico: הָאֵ֥ל מָעוּזִּ֖י חָ֑יִל וַיַּתֵּ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים דרכו׃

controles.web: God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.
controles.kjv: God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect.
controles.livre: Deus é o que com virtude me corrobora, e o que tira os obstáculos do meu caminho;

versos.hebraico: מְשַׁוֶּ֥ה רגליו כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּמוֹתַ֖י יַעֲמִדֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: He makes his feet like hinds’ feet, and sets me on my high places.
controles.kjv: He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet: and setteth me upon my high places.
controles.livre: O que faz meus pés como de cervas, E o que me assenta em minhas alturas;

versos.hebraico: מְלַמֵּ֥ד יָדַ֖י לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְנִחַ֥ת קֶֽשֶׁת־נְחוּשָׁ֖ה זְרֹעֹתָֽי׃

controles.web: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of brass.
controles.kjv: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
controles.livre: O que ensina minhas mãos para a luta, e proporciona que com meus braços quebre o arco de bronze.

versos.hebraico: וַתִּתֶּן־לִ֖י מָגֵ֣ן יִשְׁעֶ֑ךָ וַעֲנֹתְךָ֖ תַּרְבֵּֽנִי׃

controles.web: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your gentleness has made me great.
controles.kjv: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.
controles.livre: Tu me deste também o escudo de tua salvação, E tua benignidade me acrescentou.

versos.hebraico: תַּרְחִ֥יב צַעֲדִ֖י תַּחְתֵּ֑נִי וְלֹ֥א מָעֲד֖וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי׃

controles.web: You have enlarged my steps under me. My feet have not slipped.
controles.kjv: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.
controles.livre: Tu alargaste meus desfiladeiros debaixo de mim, Para que não titubeassem meus joelhos.

versos.hebraico: אֶרְדְּפָ֥ה אֹיְבַ֖י וָאַשְׁמִידֵ֑ם וְלֹ֥א אָשׁ֖וּב עַד־כַּלּוֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them. I didn’t turn again until they were consumed.
controles.kjv: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.
controles.livre: Perseguirei a meus inimigos, e os quebrantarei; E não me voltarei até que os acabe.

versos.hebraico: וָאֲכַלֵּ֥ם וָאֶמְחָצֵ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יְקוּמ֑וּן וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽי׃

controles.web: I have consumed them, and struck them through, so that they can’t arise. Yes, they have fallen under my feet.
controles.kjv: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.
controles.livre: Os consumirei, e os ferirei, e não se levantarão; E cairão debaixo de meus pés.

versos.hebraico: וַתַּזְרֵ֥נִי חַ֖יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֥יעַ קָמַ֖י תַּחְתֵּֽנִי׃

controles.web: For you have armed me with strength for the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
controles.kjv: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.
controles.livre: Cingiste-me de força para a batalha, E fizeste prostrar debaixo de mim os que contra mim se levantaram.

versos.hebraico: וְאֹ֣יְבַ֔י תַּ֥תָּה לִּ֖י עֹ֑רֶף מְשַׂנְאַ֖י וָאַצְמִיתֵֽם׃

controles.web: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
controles.kjv: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.
controles.livre: Tu me deste o pescoço de meus inimigos, De meus aborrecedores, que eu os destruísse.

versos.hebraico: יִשְׁע֖וּ וְאֵ֣ין מֹשִׁ֑יעַ אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א עָנָֽם׃

controles.web: They looked, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.
controles.kjv: They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the Lord, but he answered them not.
controles.livre: Olharam, e não houve quem os livrasse; Ao SENHOR, mas não lhes respondeu.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶשְׁחָקֵ֖ם כַּעֲפַר־אָ֑רֶץ כְּטִיט־חוּצ֥וֹת אֲדִקֵּ֖ם אֶרְקָעֵֽם׃

controles.web: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth. I crushed them as the mire of the streets, and spread them abroad.
controles.kjv: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad.
controles.livre: Eu os esmiuçarei como pó da terra; Eu os pisarei como à lama das ruas, e os dissiparei.

versos.hebraico: וַֽתְּפַלְּטֵ֔נִי מֵרִיבֵ֖י עַמִּ֑י תִּשְׁמְרֵ֨נִי֙ לְרֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֔ם עַ֥ם לֹא־יָדַ֖עְתִּי יַעַבְדֻֽנִי׃

controles.web: You also have delivered me from the strivings of my people. You have kept me to be the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known will serve me.
controles.kjv: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me.
controles.livre: Tu me livraste das brigas dos povos; Tu me guardaste para eu que fosse cabeça de nações: Povos que eu não conhecia me serviram.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֥י נֵכָ֖ר יִתְכַּֽחֲשׁוּ־לִ֑י לִשְׁמ֥וֹעַ אֹ֖זֶן יִשָּׁ֥מְעוּ לִֽי׃

controles.web: The foreigners will submit themselves to me. As soon as they hear of me, they will obey me.
controles.kjv: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.
controles.livre: Os estrangeiros se sujeitaram a mim; ao ouvirem, me obedeciam.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֥י נֵכָ֖ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְיַחְגְּר֖וּ מִמִּסְגְּרוֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: The foreigners will fade away, and will come trembling out of their close places.
controles.kjv: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.
controles.livre: Os estrangeiros desfaleciam, E tremiam em seus esconderijos.

versos.hebraico: חַי־יְהוָ֖ה וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְיָרֻ֕ם אֱלֹהֵ֖י צ֥וּר יִשְׁעִֽי׃

controles.web: Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock! Exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,
controles.kjv: The Lord liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.
controles.livre: Viva o SENHOR, e seja bendita minha rocha; Seja exaltado o Deus, a rocha de meu salvamento:

versos.hebraico: הָאֵ֕ל הַנֹּתֵ֥ן נְקָמֹ֖ת לִ֑י וּמוֹרִ֥יד עַמִּ֖ים תַּחְתֵּֽנִי׃

controles.web: even the God who executes vengeance for me, who brings down peoples under me,
controles.kjv: It is God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me,
controles.livre: O Deus que me vingou, E sujeita os povos debaixo de mim:

versos.hebraico: וּמוֹצִיאִ֖י מֵאֹֽיְבָ֑י וּמִקָּמַי֙ תְּר֣וֹמְמֵ֔נִי מֵאִ֥ישׁ חֲמָסִ֖ים תַּצִּילֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: who brings me away from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
controles.kjv: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
controles.livre: E que me tira dentre meus inimigos: Tu me tiraste em alto dentre os que se levantaram contra mim: Livraste-me do homem de iniquidades.

versos.hebraico: עַל־כֵּ֛ן אוֹדְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וּלְשִׁמְךָ֖ אֲזַמֵּֽר׃

controles.web: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
controles.kjv: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.
controles.livre: Portanto eu te confessarei entre as nações, ó SENHOR, E cantarei a teu nome.

versos.hebraico: מגדיל יְשׁוּע֣וֹת מַלְכּ֑וֹ וְעֹֽשֶׂה־חֶ֧סֶד לִמְשִׁיח֛וֹ לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְע֖וֹ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃פ

controles.web: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his seed, forever more.”
controles.kjv: He is the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.
controles.livre: Ele que engrandece as saúdes de seu rei, E faz misericórdia a seu ungido, A Davi, e à sua semente, para sempre.
